Surat and Mumbai's bullion trade split: India's gold demand fell 29% year-on-year as smuggled gold jumped over 1,500% to 50 tonnes, the WGC says.

Jewellery -20%, imports -46%. WGC says India more than doubled the duty, to 15%. Source: PTI, New Indian Express, Free Press Journal, 3 Nov.

ભારતમાં સોનાની માંગ ૨૯% ઘટી, પણ દાણચોરીનું સોનું ૧,૫૦૦% વધ્યું: વિશ્વ ગોલ્ડ કાઉન્સિલનો અહેવાલ.

Correction: our 31 Oct post wrongly tied Russia's 35-40% share to Mr Gorsiya; VTV Gujarati gives it unattributed.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs11,972/g, 22K Rs10,974/g; silver Rs1,51,108/kg, 3 Nov, USD/INR 94.83.
